name: Cost of Living
shortDescription: A DHS information directory connecting South Australians with concessions, financial assistance, food relief and help with household expenses.
plainEnglishSummary: If you are struggling with bills, food, rent, mortgage payments or other everyday costs, this page can help you explore relevant concessions and financial support services.
audience: People having difficulty paying household bills
People seeking food or financial relief
People having difficulty paying rent or a mortgage
People looking for concessions or financial counselling
availabilityNote: This page is an information directory. Availability, fees and eligibility conditions vary across the concessions and services linked from the page.
eligibilityNote: Community Connect cannot confirm eligibility for concessions or financial assistance. Each linked program has its own eligibility requirements, application process and availability.
